subject: Veridian evaluation roadmap & MAP intro: alignment on goals and timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@veridian.health>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@veridian.health>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian evaluation roadmap & MAP intro: alignment on goals and timeline

Sanjay / Alicia —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. As promised, I wanted to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) going so we have clear owners, success criteria, and a close timeline for the Veridian PoC. High level ask: confirm that the goals and dates below match your expectations and flag any missing stakeholders.

Objectives (proposed)
- Validate integration with EHR connector for de-identified clinical summaries
- Achieve 90% precision on extraction tasks on the pilot dataset
- Measure latency at 95th pct < 350ms per request under expected load

Proposed timeline
- Week of Jan 19: Kickoff technical deep dive (SE + engineering)
- Jan 26–Feb 6: Data ingest & mapping; security questionnaire completed
- Feb 9–Feb 20: Evaluate quality on held-out set; weekly checkpoints
- Week of Feb 23: Executive review and commercial decision

Recommended owners
- Customer champion / success criteria: Sanjay Rao (Veridian)
- Procurement: Tom Wallace (Veridian) — please confirm contact included
- Redwood AE: Marcus Lin (I’ll run the MAP and commercial touches)
- Redwood SE: Rafael Mendes (technical integration and performance)
- Redwood CSM: Neha Kapoor (success metrics & adoption plan)

Attached is a simple MAP template (Veridian_MAP_v1.xlsx) with the milestones/owners above. If you agree, let’s lock a 60-minute technical kickoff for Jan 20 or Jan 21 — Rafael and I are available both days in the afternoon PT.

Next steps
1) Confirm champion, procurement, and SE/CSM owners on your side
2) Confirm preferred kickoff slot (Jan 20/21 afternoon PT)
3) We’ll circulate the MAP worksheet and an initial agenda beforehand

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: Veridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 28KB)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@veridian.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@veridian.health>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian evaluation roadmap & MAP intro: alignment on goals and timeline

Marcus —

Thanks, that structure looks good. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Confirmed champion: I’ll own evaluation success and internal stakeholder alignment
- Primary evaluation lead: Alicia Gomez (cc’d) — she’ll manage the dataset and quality checks
- Procurement contact: Tom Wallace (tom.wallace@veridian.health) — I’ve looped him on the next reply

A couple of notes on timeline: the Feb 23 exec review works for us if we can have a mid-review with engineering by Feb 16 (so we have one more iteration on quality). Also, the security questionnaire is a gating item — we’ll need a SOC2 scope / data residency note from your side during the Jan 26–Feb 6 window.

For kickoff, Jan 21 at 2:00 PM PT works better for Alicia and me. Please send a calendar invite with a brief agenda.

Appreciate it —
Sanjay
VP Clinical Ops | Veridian Health

Thanks for the quick alignment — looping Tom and confirming the Jan 21 kickoff at 2:00 PM PT. Calendar invite sent. Rafael and I will share a short agenda and the MAP worksheet before the meeting.

Addressing items Sanjay called out:
- Security & compliance: Rafael will share a concise SOC2 scope note and our data handling summary ahead of the Jan 21 meeting. We can also book a follow-up call with our security SME if needed (I’ve cc’d Neha to help coordinate).
- Mid-review: agree to schedule a Feb 16 mid-review checkpoint after the initial evaluation window — I’ve tentatively added it to the invite as a placeholder.

Deliverables we’ll track on the MAP (initial)
- MAP worksheet with milestones, owners, and dates (attached)
- Access instructions for staging dataset and EHR connector (Rafael)
- Security questionnaire response and SOC2 scope note (Rafael)
- Weekly short status note (Neha will own cadence)

If that looks right I’ll mark the MAP as 'Live' after the kickoff and update the shared Drive folder with versioning.

Best,
Marcus
